item.text: {"text":"{\"status\":\"NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT\",\"core_findings\":[\"Electronics has the weakest in-sample neural separation: 22.3% of margins are negative and its 10th-percentile margin is -1.0488; Industrial_and_Scientific also has 10.68% negative margins. Fused ranking and validation HR@10 are unavailable, so these diagnostics cannot establish generalization or overall ranking quality.\"],\"key_implications\":[\"Electronics most frequently scores loader negatives above positives among the measured training positions.\",\"Embedding alignment is highest in CDs_and_Vinyl (0.7765), but alignment alone establishes neither representation collapse nor recommendation diversity.\"],\"evidence\":{\"headline_metrics\":{\"Electronics:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":0.223,\"Electronics:pos_neg_margin_p10\":-1.0488,\"Industrial_and_Scientific:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":0.1068,\"Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":0.0492,\"CDs_and_Vinyl:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":0.0214,\"CDs_and_Vinyl:embedding_collapse_score\":0.7765,\"CDs_and_Vinyl:prefix_suffix_audit_failed_queries\":1},\"brief_metric_read\":{\"pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":\"Fraction of sampled valid training positions with negative neural margins; excludes fused scores.\",\"embedding_collapse_score\":\"Mapped mean item-embedding cosine similarity; measures alignment only.\",\"prefix_suffix_audit_failed_queries\":\"One of ten bounded comparisons failed tolerance; insufficient to establish a general causality violation.\"}}}"}
